revisedDiagnosis.denialCausalityLimit: The audit hook captures a socket-origin module internally, but the public prerequisite drops it and the dashboard wrapper drops exception classification. Do not claim a particular download host, socket event, dependency telemetry source, or exception caused exit without that generated observation. The missing-dist recovery path is independently established and sufficient to justify the bounded harness repair.
revisedDiagnosis.summary: The owned pinned source archive has no built dashboard dist. The real public --skip-build command promises a dist; it does not unconditionally bypass builds. It performs a recovery build on a missing default index, entering source_build_env and pm.ensure(npm) before dashboard readiness. Both saved candidates contain the lock created only by that recovery-build path and still lack index.html. This is a concrete harness prerequisite failure.
